reason: Net-additive test-isolation guard required by ruling esc-11734-1: conftest.py::_refuse_the_operators_roster_file makes any config load that resolves the session's default verify-host roster path fail loudly, so a test that rebuilds its env and drops the ORCH_VERIFY_HOSTS_FILE pin can never read the operator's private roster. Its two imports stay function-local like conftest's other orchestrator imports (a module-top import after the sys.path setup needs an E402 suppression, removed in step-12); the try/except tolerates a session with neither HOME nor XDG_CONFIG_HOME set.
